text:
Predicates:
NamedAfter(x, y) ::: x is named after y.
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Island(x) ::: x is an island.
PartOf(x, y) ::: x is part of y.
Location(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Cove(x) ::: x is a cove.
Settlement(x) ::: x is a settlement.
SouthShetlandIslands(x) ::: x is in the South Shetland Islands.
Antarctica(x) ::: x is Antarctica.
LocatedInPlace(x, y) ::: x is located in place y.

Premises:
BarutinCove ∧ NamedAfter(BarutinCove, Barutin) ::: Barutin Cove is a cove named after the settlement of Barutin.
LocatedIn(BarutinCove, SnowIsland) ::: Barutin Cove is on the southwest coast of Snow Island.
SnowIsland ∧ GreenwichIsland ∧ DeceptionIsland ∧ SouthShetlandIslands ∧ Antarctica ::: Snow Island, Greenwich Island, Deception Island are located in the South Shetland Islands, and Antarctica is located on the South Shetland Islands.
∀x ∀y (LocatedIn(x, y) ∧ LocatedIn(y, z)) → LocatedIn(x, z) ::: If place A is located in place B and place B is located in place C, then place A is located in place C.

Conclusion:
∀x (Island(x) ∧ NamedAfter(BarutinCove, x)) → False ::: Barutin Cove is not named after all islands in Antarctica.
